_comment: `group-h` must come before `group-c`, or `group-c` takes `h.cjs` as a dependency of `c1.js`. `h.cjs` needs the runtime, which goes into `group-h.js`, a chunk that `group-c.js` imports next to the merged `other.js` chunk and `group-b.js`. The debug check of the runtime host must sort these imports with the entry chunk key of `assign_chunk_exec_orders`, or it panics here.
